'''2005 New York State Championship Scott Lingrell LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2005 New York State Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell (2005-09-07).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35135 Lingrell's Hyperbounce]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070211002754/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35135&PHPSESSID=84d2b1152e98cb77a826b3278db9feed Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Posted Sept 2005; may differ slightly from the July 2005 NY States list.<ref name="src" />
